svg.title: Game completion — save once, even when retried
svg.desc: Use case: any game ends (checkmate, draw, resign, timeout, abandonment). The room builds an immutable snapshot with a fresh completion_uuid; listeners run after the mutex is released, and the save runs on a worker so no player waits for the database.
